verified_facts.text: The hotel is in the Marqués de Riscal City of Wine in the medieval town of Elciego, in Rioja Alavesa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the medieval town of Elciego, the Hotel Marques de Riscal and its surrounding City of Wine provide the ideal starting point

verified_facts.text: The hotel was designed by architect Frank O. Gehry.
verified_facts.excerpt: This stunning 21st-century chateau was designed by internationally renowned architect Frank O. Gehry

verified_facts.text: The building's avant-garde design is characterized by flowing lines and titanium ribbons.
verified_facts.excerpt: With its avant-garde design characterized by flowing lines and titanium ribbons, the hotel stands as an icon of modernity amidst the traditional landscape of Rioja Alavesa.

verified_facts.text: The main building has a red-, silver- and gold-metal ribbon roof.
verified_facts.excerpt: though its red-, silver-, and gold-metal ribbon roof is stunning

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in the heart of a wine cellar, something Gehry had never designed before.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mr. Gehry was seduced by the challenge of designing a hotel located in the heart of a wine cellar, something he had never done before.

verified_facts.text: Marqués de Riscal winery, founded in 1858, is the oldest winery in the region.
verified_facts.excerpt: The expansive vineyard, dates back to 1858, making Marqués de Riscal the oldest winery in the region.

verified_facts.text: Guests can join daily tours of the winery, from fermenting rooms to oak-barrel aging rooms and a cellar housing eight million bottles.
verified_facts.excerpt: The fascinating journey from grapevine to bottle unfolds as visitors make their way from fermenting rooms to aging rooms stacked high with oak barrels to the enormous cellar housing eight million bottles of wine.

verified_facts.text: The 'Cathedral' cellar holds bottles from nearly every vintage since the winery's founding.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests will find the 'Cathedral,' a bottle cellar in which Marqués de Riscal guards its greatest treasure—a priceless collection of bottles from nearly every vintage since the winery's founding.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have views of the countryside, the medieval town of Elciego or the hotel's architecture.
verified_facts.excerpt: enviable views of the countryside, the medieval town of Elciego or the striking architecture

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature bedside cloud lamps made of white fabric balloons and green and black Italian marble baths.
verified_facts.excerpt: From bedside cloud lamps made of white fabric balloons to the spacious green and black Italian marble baths

verified_facts.text: Every room and suite greets guests with a complimentary bottle of Rioja wine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every room and suite at Hotel Marqués de Riscal greets guests with a complimentary bottle of Rioja wine

verified_facts.text: The Gehry Suite is a loft-like suite in the Gehry Wing with a private terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the Gehry Wing, this alluring loft-like Suite offers an iconic level of design as well as an exquisite private terrace.

verified_facts.text: The Riscal Suites Terrace are loft-style suites in the Spa wing, connected to the Gehry building by a glass bridge by Gehry.
verified_facts.excerpt: The loft-style Riscal Suites Terrace, 65 sqm, in the Spa wing, connect to Gehry building via glass bridge by Frank O. Gehry.

verified_facts.text: Most guest rooms are in a spa annex built into a hill, reached by a glass-enclosed bridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: most of the 43 guest rooms are actually in a bunkerlike spa annex built into a hill and reached by a glass-enclosed bridge

verified_facts.text: The Vinothérapie Spa Caudalie Marqués de Riscal is surrounded by, and has views of, the estate's vineyards.
verified_facts.excerpt: Surrounded by, and with enchanting views of, the lush vineyards of the Marqués de Riscal estate this 1,400-square-meter haven of wellness promotes the rejuvenation of both mind and body.

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments by vinotherapy specialists trained in Bordeaux are based on the essence of the grape.
verified_facts.excerpt: Specialists in vinotherapy trained in the Bordeaux wine region employ wet and dry treatments based on the essence of the grape to cleanse, soothe and invigorate the skin.

verified_facts.text: A Barrel Bath lets guests soak in a bubbly mix of grape pomace.
verified_facts.excerpt: A unique Barrel Bath allows guests to soak in a bubbly mix of grape pomace.

verified_facts.text: The spa journey includes a heated indoor pool with water jets, a hammam, a Finnish sauna and a rainforest shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: A delightful journey from the heated indoor swimming pool with its pummeling water jets, to the hammam, the Finnish sauna, and the rainforest shower

verified_facts.text: The Library on the top floor has a large outdoor terrace suspended among the titanium waves on the building's exterior.
verified_facts.excerpt: When the sun shines, admire the estate’s natural beauty from the large outdoor terrace suspended among the titanium waves swirling over the building’s exterior.

verified_facts.text: 1860 Tradición is an airy second-floor restaurant with panoramic views of the vineyards and Elciego.
verified_facts.excerpt: Panoramic views of the vineyards and Elciego decorate our airy, second-floor restaurant.

verified_facts.text: Guests can explore the surroundings on the hotel's complimentary bicycles (subject to availability).
verified_facts.excerpt: exploring its surroundings is easy on one of the hotel’s complimentary bicycles (subject to availability)

verified_facts.text: The Luxury Collection Concierge can arrange cultural tours at nearby wineries and private golf outings.
verified_facts.excerpt: From behind-the-scenes cultural tours at nearby wineries to private golf outings, they will handle every request with efficiency and aplomb.

verified_facts.text: The Santiago pilgrimage route passes a few kilometres from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Santiago Pilgrimage route—representing centuries of European history—passes only a few kilometres from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel celebrated its Grand Opening in October 2006.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel celebrated its Grand Opening in October 2006.

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets Not Allowed

verified_facts.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, rooms at Hotel Marqués de Riscal, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Elciego do not have a fridge.

verified_facts.text: Self parking is complimentary for guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Self parking is complimentary for guests.

verified_facts.text: Young guests are provided with special bath products, bottle warmers and edge and socket guards.
verified_facts.excerpt: The comfort of our youngest guests is ensured with special bath products, bottle warmers, as well as edge and socket guards.
